summary: This research study is testing a medicine called NNC0487-0111 given as a weekly injection under the skin to see how it helps adults with excess body weight and obstructive sleep apnoea, a condition where breathing repeatedly stops and starts during sleep. Participants will receive either the study drug or a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks just like the medicine. Novo Nordisk A/S is sponsoring this Phase 3 clinical trial, which aims to enroll 300 participants.
